items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: Ori had a good band and Jack Carey. Oh yes. Well them was famous bands, Jack Carey

ctx.x: Alright, see you later. Alright, see you later.

Ori had a good band and Jack Carey. Oh yes. Well them was famous bands, Jack Carey, and that's the time we was advertising then. On trucks for, for, for, for dancers, you see. Did your band play on those trucks at the L2, to advertise? Oh man, sure. T.L. gate, man, you hang, back up, like that call backing up there and tie up there in the stadium and play yourself crazy. What they was doing that for, I don't know. Man, every time they see a band, they'll catch them. Make them play. Stop them and buck them. To see…
